title: test_fragment seals_wire failure: sender validation raises SchcError 'packet too short: need 23 bytes for residue of rule 0, got 10'
description: P1 pre-existing failure on HEAD (verified with HEAD's own test file): python/tests/schc/test_fragment.py::test_fragment_sender_validates_before_allocation_and_seals_wire_once fails at python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py:863 with SchcError 'packet too short: need 23 bytes for residue of rule 0, got 10'. The test expects the sender to validate the plaintext packet BEFORE allocating fragment state and to seal the wire exactly once. Either the rule-0 residue sizing in headers.py or the test's fixture packet is wrong; needs root-cause, not test deletion. Known-unrelated: NOT caused by the 2026-08-29 orphaned-wave adoption commit.
